name: modern-drivers-app
description: Modern Drivers — the Android app a driver installs

scripts.build:debug: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug

_comment_native_project: android/ is generated by `npx cap add android`, not committed: this app has no hand-written native code, so a committed tree would be 200+ files of generated Gradle config to re-sync on every Capacitor bump. scripts/patch-manifest.js applies the one thing cap add does not know about — the background-location permissions and the Android 14 foregroundServiceType.
